exposure: distance between transabdominal cerclage and external os
gestational age of previous preterm birth
cohort: The study included 87 women with cervical insufficiency who underwent transabdominal cerclage by open laparotomy during the first and early second trimester of pregnancy over a 20-year period.
finding: The efficacy of transabdominal cerclage placement via open laparotomy in high-risk pregnancies is favorable, resulting in a 92% fetal survival rate and a median gestational age at delivery of 37.3 weeks, irrespective of the indication for the procedure or other risk factors.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 37.3 weeks, with 92% of deliveries >=34 weeks.
